text: Assumption: The return value E_OK marks the regular termination of the asynchronous query process, after which the parameter supported is valid — is this correct?
text_en: Assumption: The return value E_OK marks the regular termination of the asynchronous query process, after which the parameter supported is valid — is this correct?
norm: the return value e_ok marks the regular termination of the asynchronous query process after which the parameter supported is valid
assumption: The return value E_OK marks the regular termination of the asynchronous query process, after which the parameter supported is valid.
rationale: In SWS_Dcm_00803, E_OK is literally described with "when the Did is finally available", whereas supported can also return DCM_DID_NOT_SUPPORTED.
